To check the current weather in **Berlin, Germany**, you can use reliable weather services like:

- **[Weather.com (The Weather Channel)](https://weather.com)**
- **[AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com)**
- **[Windy.com](https://www.windy.com)** (for real-time updates)
- **[Meteoblue](https://www.meteoblue.com)** (detailed forecasts)

### **Quick Check (Example - as of my last update):**
- **Temperature:** ~15–20°C (varies by time of day)
- **Conditions:** Likely partly cloudy or sunny (depends on the season)
- **Wind:** Light to moderate

For the **most accurate real-time data**, I recommend checking one of the links above. Would you like help interpreting the forecast? 😊
